_comment: Route-scoped (src/server/**) test-failure ratchet baseline, consumed by check-test-baseline.ts
via npm run check:route-test-baseline. Failing tests listed here do NOT fail CI; anything NOT
listed here that fails DOES. See that script header for the full mechanics and the ratchet
precedent (check-admin-complexity-drift.ts, Jini guard:drift) this mirrors.
HONESTY NOTE (2026-08-16, written while seeding this file -- read before trusting this list):
This was captured via a real npm run test:cov:server run under heavy concurrent load (7 agents
active in this same checkout simultaneously). It has 57 unique failing test names -- MORE than
the 28 the session Coordinator independently verified earlier tonight against an isolated
git-worktree run (no concurrent load), for a closely related but not identical scope
(src/server/__tests__/** there vs src/server/**/*.test.ts here, a superset that also includes
co-located route __tests__/ files). Spot-checked one specific case
(identity-crud-routes.test.ts, AC-27/28/29, "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading
principalId)") by running that one file alone in this shell -- it still failed, but that does
NOT rule out a shared on-disk SQLite fixture race with another agent concurrently running tests
in this same repo checkout (a real, previously-documented failure class here -- see
reference_shared_fixture_db_name_race in project memory -- not confirmed as the cause in this
specific instance, just not ruled out). This baseline was still seeded from the full 57 (not the
cleaner 28) because a ratchet that starts narrower than reality is immediately red on arrival for
the wrong reason, which is worse than starting from what was actually observed.
ACTION NEEDED: re-run npm run test:cov:server in a quiet moment (no concurrent agent activity),
diff the resulting failing-name set against this list, and prune every entry that no longer
fails (check-route-test-baseline already reports stale entries as a non-blocking prompt to do
exactly this -- it does not do it automatically). Until that happens, treat this baseline as
real-but-possibly-generous, not as a confirmed-clean debt list.
PRUNED 2026-08-17 (57 -> 48): a solo, quiet npm run test:cov:server run at general-work HEAD
b68e2b40 confirmed 9 of the above ACTION-NEEDED entries now pass ('ok', not 'not ok', in the
resulting TAP -- individually verified by name, not just by absence). Removed: the
knownHelpersOnly, malformed-workerData, output-escaping-worker, publish-site-preview-netlify,
publish-site-trigger, renderSite-Liquid-render_block-footer, renderSite-fallback-minimal-body,
renders-a-well-behaved-template, and render_block-seam-registry entries. Left everything else
untouched -- the other 48 were independently re-confirmed still failing in that same run.
This prune is unrelated to the CI run-32093877745 '15 new / 15 fixed' report investigated the
same night (see the comment above the fixedFailures block in check-test-baseline.ts) -- that
report's 'newFailures' were bare file paths from transient CI-runner file-level test crashes,
never matched to this list, and none were added here.
PRUNED 2026-08-19 (48 -> 42): CI run 32276252951 (general-work, post-ESM-migration) reported
these 6 entries no longer fail. Removed: the two 'POST /api/site-assistant/chat' history-related
entries, the 429-rate-limit entry, the two worker defensive-re-lint entries (disallowed
construct/tag), and the syntax-error-surfaces-as-rejection entry. Verified against that run's own
check:route-test-baseline output, not re-run locally.
knownFailures: /api/admin/v1/assistant/byok-turn (azure protocol): a real tool round-trips through the OpenAI-compatible chat/completions wire shape
/api/admin/v1/assistant/byok-turn (google protocol): a real tool round-trips through Gemini's streamGenerateContent wire shape
/api/admin/v1/assistant/byok-turn (openai protocol): a FAILED tool call folds isError into the content string, not a discarded field
/api/admin/v1/assistant/byok-turn runs a REAL admin tool through a BYOK provider turn and streams a real result back
/api/admin/v1/assistant/byok-turn: an UNREDEEMED confirmation resolves via its own bounded TTL — it does not hang the request for anywhere near the production 5.5-minute ceiling
/api/admin/v1/assistant/byok-turn: cancelling the same confirmation dialog leaves the post untouched
/api/admin/v1/assistant/byok-turn: content_post_delete PARKS via a real emitSurface, and redeeming the confirmation through the LOCAL (non-daemon) delivery path actually deletes the post
AC-27: ENABLE_PRINCIPAL route re-activates a disabled user
AC-28: UPDATE_USER route sets email, ignores username/password fields in the body
AC-29: RESET_USER_PASSWORD route returns 204 and the new password authenticates a fresh login
ADR-027 §4: a published post with a legacy src-only image node still renders the placeholder on a real GET /:slug — no backward-compat regression through the real HTTP path
POST /api/site-assistant/chat never emits a client_directive for a trashed-but-published, unpublished, or nonexistent slug (SPEC-046 Task 2 AC5)
POST /api/site-assistant/chat writes a well-formed client_directive SSE frame when a page-action tool resolves (SPEC-046 REQ-4)
REGRESSION: a post whose templateChoice was never set renders its real content, not the diagnostic page
ROUND TRIP: saving "No template chosen" through the admin API persists "" and diagnoses on the site
T045: the real home-page render includes SEO's folded <title> tag, not just the raw shell default
a memory-blowup template (range within the lint cap, accumulating retained allocations) is force-terminated by the worker's memory guards
a post explicitly opted out of templates still gets the diagnostic page
admin menus routes: ADR-PIPE-012 D-1/D-2/D-9 — a principal with no grants is denied 403 on every route with the new per-action permission named, and a grant restores access
an explicit templateChoice renders through that template, not the first one
both logic tiers see the identical render-data contract — the same fields resolve in Liquid and in Handlebars
null and "" produce different pages for otherwise identical posts
overridesThemePage true composes with the templateChoice fallback rather than bypassing it
packet-one admin and content routes expose the seeded post loop
publish-site preview: github-pages reports the derived base path and, with no GITHUB_TOKEN configured, credentialsConfigured false — never starting a run
renderDocNode: a legacy src-only node still degrades to the placeholder even when mediaTransformVersions is non-empty — the ref path only activates on assetId+transformName, never on src
renderDocNode: an image node no longer vanishes — it degrades to the media placeholder using alt text as the label, and never emits src/title (D7)
renderDocNode: an image node with no/non-string alt falls back to a generic 'Image' label, never crashes
renderSite (Handlebars tier): an unknown component id degrades to a comment, not a crash
renderSite (Handlebars tier): {{render_block region="footer"}} resolves the same widget list over the same seam the Liquid tier uses (ADR-047 §2a)
renderSite (Slice 2): a data-embed-type="widget" embed substitutes to its resolved widget IR; an id with no matching entry in the resolved map degrades to the REQ-28 placeholder
renderSite (Slice 2): an html Page's embed placeholders degrade safely when pageHtmlEmbeds is omitted entirely — never leaks the raw data-embed-type markup
renderSite (Slice 2): an unknown embed type degrades to the REQ-28 placeholder exactly like a known-type resolution failure — render.ts never distinguishes the two externally

renderSite (Slice 2, media): a malformed media-image IR (missing assetId — should never happen from this codebase's own resolver, defense-in-depth only) degrades to the ordinary widget placeholder rather than a malformed
renderSite (Slice 2, media): a resolved data-embed-type="media" embed renders a real through the same /m/ URL contract the TipTap ref-image case uses
renderSite (Slice 2, media): width/height/class are each omitted independently when null, never a zeroed/empty attribute
renderSite escapes a hostile post title rather than emitting it as markup (autoescaping is on, mirroring Liquid's outputEscape)
renderSite falls back rather than throwing when a handlebars template is a syntax error
renderSite falls back to the minimal built-in body (never 500s) when a handlebars theme's source is hostile at render time
renderSite falls back when a handlebars theme has no template for the requested route (partial theme never 500s)
renderSite renders the live ledger entry (post) page: content injected raw, title escaped in body and in the shell
renderSite renders the live themes/handlebars/ledger home page: header/footer components, entry rows, escaped titles, no leftover Handlebars syntax
